        "# 2. Write Main App Source (Scientific + boAt Sync + Personal Hub Vault)\n",
        "app_script = '''\n",
        "import os\n",
        "import math\n",
        "from kivy.app import App\n",
        "from kivy.uix.boxlayout import BoxLayout\n",
        "from kivy.uix.gridlayout import GridLayout\n",
        "from kivy.uix.button import Button\n",
        "from kivy.uix.togglebutton import ToggleButton\n",
        "from kivy.uix.textinput import TextInput\n",
        "from kivy.uix.label import Label\n",
        "from kivy.uix.popup import Popup\n",
        "from kivy.uix.image import Image\n",
        "from kivy.uix.scrollview import ScrollView\n",
        "from kivy.utils import platform\n",
        "from kivy.core.window import Window\n",
        "\n",
        "DARK_BG = (0.04, 0.05, 0.07, 1)\n",
        "DARK_CARD = (0.08, 0.10, 0.14, 1)\n",
        "LIGHT_BG = (0.92, 0.94, 0.96, 1)\n",
        "LIGHT_CARD = (1, 1, 1, 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "def send_watch_alert(title, text):\n",
        "    if platform == 'android':\n",
        "        try:\n",
        "            from jnius import autoclass\n",
        "            PythonActivity = autoclass('org.kivy.android.PythonActivity')\n",
        "            Context = autoclass('android.content.Context')\n",
        "            NotificationManager = autoclass('android.app.NotificationManager')\n",
        "            NotificationChannel = autoclass('android.app.NotificationChannel')\n",
        "            NotificationCompatBuilder = autoclass('androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat$Builder')\n",
        "\n",
        "            ctx = PythonActivity.mActivity\n",
        "            mgr = ctx.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE)\n",
        "            cid = \"boat_sync_channel\"\n",
        "            channel = NotificationChannel(cid, \"boAt Alerts\", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_HIGH)\n",
        "            mgr.createNotificationChannel(channel)\n",
        "\n",
        "            b = NotificationCompatBuilder(ctx, cid)\n",
        "            b.setContentTitle(f\"Calc: {title}\")\n",
        "            b.setContentText(f\"= {text}\")\n",
        "            b.setSmallIcon(ctx.getApplicationInfo().icon)\n",
        "            b.setPriority(NotificationCompatBuilder.PRIORITY_HIGH)\n",
        "            mgr.notify(101, b.build())\n",
        "        except Exception:\n",
        "            pass\n",
        "\n",
        "class ProScientificApp(App):\n",
        "    def build(self):\n",
        "        self.is_dark = True\n",
        "        self.boat_sync = True\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Link directly to persistent external app directory for maximum media storage\n",
        "        if platform == 'android':\n",
        "            from jnius import autoclass\n",
        "            PythonActivity = autoclass('org.kivy.android.PythonActivity')\n",
        "            ctx = PythonActivity.mActivity\n",
        "            ext_dir = ctx.getExternalFilesDir(None)\n",
        "            self.hub_dir = os.path.join(ext_dir.getAbsolutePath(), \".personal_hub\")\n",
        "        else:\n",
        "            self.hub_dir = os.path.join(self.user_data_dir, \".personal_hub\")\n",
        "\n",
        "        os.makedirs(self.hub_dir, exist_ok=True)\n",
        "        Window.clearcolor = DARK_BG\n",
        "\n",
        "        root = BoxLayout(orientation='vertical', padding=10, spacing=6)\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Header Control Bar (boAt Toggle + Theme Toggle)\n",
        "        top = BoxLayout(size_hint=(1, 0.07), spacing=8)\n",
        "        self.boat_btn = ToggleButton(text=\"⌚ boAt: ON\", state='down', font_size=12, background_color=(0, 0.85, 0.95, 1))\n",
        "        self.boat_btn.bind(on_press=self.toggle_boat)\n",
        "        top.add_widget(self.boat_btn)\n",
        "\n",
        "        self.theme_btn = Button(text=\"☀️ Mode\", font_size=12, background_color=(0.25, 0.3, 0.4, 1))\n",
        "        self.theme_btn.bind(on_press=self.toggle_theme)\n",
        "        top.add_widget(self.theme_btn)\n",
        "        root.add_widget(top)\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Compact Display Screen\n",
        "        self.display = TextInput(text='', multiline=False, readonly=True, halign='right', font_size=32, size_hint=(1, 0.17), background_color=DARK_CARD, foreground_color=(0, 0.95, 1, 1))\n",
        "        root.add_widget(self.display)\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Hard Math & Numeric Keypad Grid\n",
        "        self.grid = GridLayout(cols=5, spacing=5, size_hint=(1, 0.76))\n",
        "        buttons = [\n",
        "            ['sin', 'cos', 'tan', 'log', 'AC'],\n",
        "            ['√', '^', '(', ')', 'DEL'],\n",
        "            ['7', '8', '9', '%', '÷'],\n",
        "            ['4', '5', '6', 'π', '×'],\n",
        "            ['1', '2', '3', 'e', '-'],\n",
        "            ['0', '.', '+', '', '=']\n",
        "        ]\n",
        "\n",
        "        self.btns = []\n",
        "        for row in buttons:\n",
        "            for lbl in row:\n",
        "                if lbl == '':\n",
        "                    self.grid.add_widget(BoxLayout())\n",
        "                    continue\n",
        "                btn = Button(text=lbl, font_size=17, bold=True)\n",
        "                self.style_btn(btn, lbl)\n",
        "                btn.bind(on_press=self.press_key)\n",
        "                self.grid.add_widget(btn)\n",
        "                self.btns.append(btn)\n",
        "\n",
        "        root.add_widget(self.grid)\n",
        "        return root\n",
        "\n",
        "    def style_btn(self, btn, lbl):\n",
        "        if lbl in ['÷', '×', '-', '+']:\n",
        "            btn.background_color = (1, 0.6, 0.05, 1)\n",
        "        elif lbl == '=':\n",
        "            btn.background_color = (0.1, 0.8, 0.4, 1)\n",
        "        elif lbl in ['AC', 'DEL']:\n",
        "            btn.background_color = (0.9, 0.25, 0.25, 1)\n",
        "        elif lbl in ['sin', 'cos', 'tan', 'log', '√', '^', 'π', 'e', '(', ')', '%']:\n",
        "            btn.background_color = (0.16, 0.22, 0.32, 1)\n",
        "        else:\n",
        "            btn.background_color = (0.12, 0.15, 0.22, 1) if self.is_dark else (0.86, 0.89, 0.93, 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "    def toggle_boat(self, instance):\n",
        "        self.boat_sync = (instance.state == 'down')\n",
        "        instance.text = \"⌚ boAt: ON\" if self.boat_sync else \"⌚ boAt: OFF\"\n",
        "        instance.background_color = (0, 0.85, 0.95, 1) if self.boat_sync else (0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "    def toggle_theme(self, instance):\n",
        "        self.is_dark = not self.is_dark\n",
        "        Window.clearcolor = DARK_BG if self.is_dark else LIGHT_BG\n",
        "        self.display.background_color = DARK_CARD if self.is_dark else LIGHT_CARD\n",
        "        for b in self.btns:\n",
        "            self.style_btn(b, b.text)\n",
        "\n",
        "    def press_key(self, instance):\n",
        "        t = instance.text\n",
        "        cur = self.display.text\n",
        "\n",
        "        if t == 'AC':\n",
        "            self.display.text = ''\n",
        "        elif t == 'DEL':\n",
        "            self.display.text = cur[:-1]\n",
        "        elif t == '=':\n",
        "            # Code: 786 opens the personal hub\n",
        "            if cur.strip() == \"786\":\n",
        "                self.display.text = ''\n",
        "                self.open_hub()\n",
        "                return\n",
        "            try:\n",
        "                expr = cur.replace('×', '*').replace('÷', '/').replace('%', '/100').replace('^', '**').replace('√', 'math.sqrt')\n",
        "                ans = str(eval(expr, {\"__builtins__\": None}, {\"math\": math}))\n",
        "                if ans.endswith('.0'):\n",
        "                    ans = ans[:-2]\n",
        "                self.display.text = ans\n",
        "                if self.boat_sync:\n",
        "                    send_watch_alert(cur, ans)\n",
        "            except Exception:\n",
        "                self.display.text = 'Error'\n",
        "        else:\n",
        "            self.display.text = cur + t\n",
        "\n",
        "    def open_hub(self):\n",
        "        box = BoxLayout(orientation='vertical', padding=10, spacing=8)\n",
        "        box.add_widget(Label(text=\"📁 Personal Hub (Device Memory Linked)\", font_size=14, size_hint=(1, 0.08), color=(0, 0.9, 1, 1)))\n",
        "\n",
        "        scroll = ScrollView(size_hint=(1, 0.82))\n",
        "        grid = GridLayout(cols=2, spacing=8, size_hint_y=None)\n",
        "        grid.bind(minimum_height=grid.setter('height'))\n",
        "\n",
        "        valid_exts = ('.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.mp4')\n",
        "        files = [f for f in os.listdir(self.hub_dir) if f.lower().endswith(valid_exts)]\n",
        "\n",
        "        if not files:\n",
        "            grid.add_widget(Label(text=\"No media found.\\\\nPlace files into device storage folder.\", size_hint_y=None, height=100, color=(0.6, 0.6, 0.7, 1)))\n",
        "        else:\n",
        "            for f in files:\n",
        "                img = Image(source=os.path.join(self.hub_dir, f), size_hint_y=None, height=130)\n",
        "                grid.add_widget(img)\n",

        "# 1. Install all prerequisites and buildozer\n",
        "!sudo apt-get update -qq\n",
        "!sudo apt-get install -y -qq git zip unzip openjdk-17-jdk autoconf libtool pkg-config zlib1g-dev libncurses5-dev libncursesw5-dev libtinfo5 cmake libffi-dev libssl-dev\n",

        "# 2. Write the App Source Code\n",
        "app_code = '''\n",
        "import os\n",
        "import math\n",
        "from kivy.app import App\n",
        "from kivy.uix.boxlayout import BoxLayout\n",
        "from kivy.uix.gridlayout import GridLayout\n",
        "from kivy.uix.button import Button\n",
        "from kivy.uix.togglebutton import ToggleButton\n",
        "from kivy.uix.textinput import TextInput\n",
        "from kivy.uix.label import Label\n",
        "from kivy.uix.popup import Popup\n",
        "from kivy.uix.image import Image\n",
        "from kivy.uix.scrollview import ScrollView\n",
        "from kivy.utils import platform\n",
        "from kivy.core.window import Window\n",
        "\n",
        "DARK_BG = (0.04, 0.05, 0.07, 1)\n",
        "DARK_CARD = (0.08, 0.10, 0.14, 1)\n",
        "LIGHT_BG = (0.92, 0.94, 0.96, 1)\n",
        "LIGHT_CARD = (1, 1, 1, 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "def send_watch_alert(title, text):\n",
        "    if platform == 'android':\n",
        "        try:\n",
        "            from jnius import autoclass\n",
        "            PythonActivity = autoclass('org.kivy.android.PythonActivity')\n",
        "            Context = autoclass('android.content.Context')\n",
        "            NotificationManager = autoclass('android.app.NotificationManager')\n",
        "            NotificationChannel = autoclass('android.app.NotificationChannel')\n",
        "            NotificationCompatBuilder = autoclass('androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat$Builder')\n",
        "\n",
        "            ctx = PythonActivity.mActivity\n",
        "            mgr = ctx.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE)\n",
        "            cid = \"boat_sync_channel\"\n",
        "            channel = NotificationChannel(cid, \"boAt Alerts\", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_HIGH)\n",
        "            mgr.createNotificationChannel(channel)\n",
        "\n",
        "            b = NotificationCompatBuilder(ctx, cid)\n",
        "            b.setContentTitle(f\"Calc: {title}\")\n",
        "            b.setContentText(f\"= {text}\")\n",
        "            b.setSmallIcon(ctx.getApplicationInfo().icon)\n",
        "            b.setPriority(NotificationCompatBuilder.PRIORITY_HIGH)\n",
        "            mgr.notify(101, b.build())\n",
        "        except Exception:\n",
        "            pass\n",
        "\n",
        "class ProScientificApp(App):\n",
        "    def build(self):\n",
        "        self.is_dark = True\n",
        "        self.boat_sync = True\n",
        "\n",
        "        if platform == 'android':\n",
        "            from jnius import autoclass\n",
        "            PythonActivity = autoclass('org.kivy.android.PythonActivity')\n",
        "            ctx = PythonActivity.mActivity\n",
        "            ext_dir = ctx.getExternalFilesDir(None)\n",
        "            self.hub_dir = os.path.join(ext_dir.getAbsolutePath(), \".personal_hub\")\n",
        "        else:\n",
        "            self.hub_dir = os.path.join(self.user_data_dir, \".personal_hub\")\n",
        "\n",
        "        os.makedirs(self.hub_dir, exist_ok=True)\n",
        "        Window.clearcolor = DARK_BG\n",
        "\n",
        "        root = BoxLayout(orientation='vertical', padding=10, spacing=6)\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Header Control Bar\n",
        "        top = BoxLayout(size_hint=(1, 0.07), spacing=8)\n",
        "        self.boat_btn = ToggleButton(text=\"⌚ boAt: ON\", state='down', font_size=12, background_color=(0, 0.85, 0.95, 1))\n",
        "        self.boat_btn.bind(on_press=self.toggle_boat)\n",
        "        top.add_widget(self.boat_btn)\n",
        "\n",
        "        self.theme_btn = Button(text=\"☀️ Mode\", font_size=12, background_color=(0.25, 0.3, 0.4, 1))\n",
        "        self.theme_btn.bind(on_press=self.toggle_theme)\n",
        "        top.add_widget(self.theme_btn)\n",
        "        root.add_widget(top)\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Screen Display\n",
        "        self.display = TextInput(text='', multiline=False, readonly=True, halign='right', font_size=32, size_hint=(1, 0.17), background_color=DARK_CARD, foreground_color=(0, 0.95, 1, 1))\n",
        "        root.add_widget(self.display)\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Math Grid\n",
        "        self.grid = GridLayout(cols=5, spacing=5, size_hint=(1, 0.76))\n",
        "        buttons = [\n",
        "            ['sin', 'cos', 'tan', 'log', 'AC'],\n",
        "            ['√', '^', '(', ')', 'DEL'],\n",
        "            ['7', '8', '9', '%', '÷'],\n",
        "            ['4', '5', '6', 'π', '×'],\n",
        "            ['1', '2', '3', 'e', '-'],\n",
        "            ['0', '.', '+', '', '=']\n",
        "        ]\n",
        "\n",
        "        self.btns = []\n",
        "        for row in buttons:\n",
        "            for lbl in row:\n",
        "                if lbl == '':\n",
        "                    self.grid.add_widget(BoxLayout())\n",
        "                    continue\n",
        "                btn = Button(text=lbl, font_size=17, bold=True)\n",
        "                self.style_btn(btn, lbl)\n",
        "                btn.bind(on_press=self.press_key)\n",
        "                self.grid.add_widget(btn)\n",
        "                self.btns.append(btn)\n",
        "\n",
        "        root.add_widget(self.grid)\n",
        "        return root\n",
        "\n",
        "    def style_btn(self, btn, lbl):\n",
        "        if lbl in ['÷', '×', '-', '+']:\n",
        "            btn.background_color = (1, 0.6, 0.05, 1)\n",
        "        elif lbl == '=':\n",
        "            btn.background_color = (0.1, 0.8, 0.4, 1)\n",
        "        elif lbl in ['AC', 'DEL']:\n",
        "            btn.background_color = (0.9, 0.25, 0.25, 1)\n",
        "        elif lbl in ['sin', 'cos', 'tan', 'log', '√', '^', 'π', 'e', '(', ')', '%']:\n",
        "            btn.background_color = (0.16, 0.22, 0.32, 1)\n",
        "        else:\n",
        "            btn.background_color = (0.12, 0.15, 0.22, 1) if self.is_dark else (0.86, 0.89, 0.93, 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "    def toggle_boat(self, instance):\n",
        "        self.boat_sync = (instance.state == 'down')\n",
        "        instance.text = \"⌚ boAt: ON\" if self.boat_sync else \"⌚ boAt: OFF\"\n",
        "        instance.background_color = (0, 0.85, 0.95, 1) if self.boat_sync else (0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "    def toggle_theme(self, instance):\n",
        "        self.is_dark = not self.is_dark\n",
        "        Window.clearcolor = DARK_BG if self.is_dark else LIGHT_BG\n",
        "        self.display.background_color = DARK_CARD if self.is_dark else LIGHT_CARD\n",
        "        for b in self.btns:\n",
        "            self.style_btn(b, b.text)\n",
        "\n",
        "    def press_key(self, instance):\n",
        "        t = instance.text\n",
        "        cur = self.display.text\n",
        "\n",
        "        if t == 'AC': self.display.text = ''\n",
        "        elif t == 'DEL': self.display.text = cur[:-1]\n",
        "        elif t == '=':\n",
        "            # Code: 786 opens personal hub\n",
        "            if cur.strip() == \"786\":\n",
        "                self.display.text = ''\n",
        "                self.open_hub()\n",
        "                return\n",
        "            try:\n",
        "                expr = cur.replace('×', '*').replace('÷', '/').replace('%', '/100').replace('^', '**').replace('√', 'math.sqrt')\n",
        "                ans = str(eval(expr, {\"__builtins__\": None}, {\"math\": math}))\n",
        "                if ans.endswith('.0'): ans = ans[:-2]\n",
        "                self.display.text = ans\n",
        "                if self.boat_sync: send_watch_alert(cur, ans)\n",
        "            except Exception:\n",
        "                self.display.text = 'Error'\n",
        "        else:\n",
        "            self.display.text = cur + t\n",
        "\n",
        "    def open_hub(self):\n",
        "        box = BoxLayout(orientation='vertical', padding=10, spacing=8)\n",
        "        box.add_widget(Label(text=\"📁 Personal Hub (Device Memory Linked)\", font_size=14, size_hint=(1, 0.08), color=(0, 0.9, 1, 1)))\n",
        "\n",
        "        scroll = ScrollView(size_hint=(1, 0.82))\n",
        "        grid = GridLayout(cols=2, spacing=8, size_hint_y=None)\n",
        "        grid.bind(minimum_height=grid.setter('height'))\n",
        "\n",
        "        files = [f for f in os.listdir(self.hub_dir) if f.lower().endswith(('.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.mp4'))]\n",
        "        if not files:\n",
        "            grid.add_widget(Label(text=\"No media found.\\\\nPlace files into device storage folder.\", size_hint_y=None, height=100, color=(0.6, 0.6, 0.7, 1)))\n",
        "        else:\n",
        "            for f in files:\n",
        "                grid.add_widget(Image(source=os.path.join(self.hub_dir, f), size_hint_y=None, height=130))\n",
        "\n",
        "        scroll.add_widget(grid)\n",
        "        box.add_widget(scroll)\n",
        "\n",
        "        close_btn = Button(text=\"Close\", size_hint=(1, 0.1), background_color=(0.8, 0.2, 0.2, 1))\n",
        "        box.add_widget(close_btn)\n",
        "\n",
        "        popup = Popup(title=\"Personal Hub\", content=box, size_hint=(0.95, 0.9), auto_dismiss=False)\n",
        "        close_btn.bind(on_press=popup.dismiss)\n",
        "        popup.open()\n",
        "\n",
        "if __name__ == '__main__':\n",
        "    ProScientificApp().run()\n",
        "'''\n",
        "\n",
        "with open(\"main.py\", \"w\") as f:\n",

        "        elif lbl in ['sin', 'cos', 'tan', 'log', '√', '^', 'π', 'e', '(', ')', '%']:\n",
        "            btn.background_color = (0.16, 0.22, 0.32, 1)\n",
        "        else:\n",
        "            btn.background_color = (0.12, 0.15, 0.22, 1) if self.is_dark else (0.86, 0.89, 0.93, 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "    def toggle_boat(self, instance):\n",
        "        self.boat_sync = (instance.state == 'down')\n",
        "        instance.text = \"⌚ boAt: ON\" if self.boat_sync else \"⌚ boAt: OFF\"\n",
        "        instance.background_color = (0, 0.85, 0.95, 1) if self.boat_sync else (0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "    def toggle_theme(self, instance):\n",
        "        self.is_dark = not self.is_dark\n",
        "        Window.clearcolor = DARK_BG if self.is_dark else LIGHT_BG\n",
        "        self.display.background_color = DARK_CARD if self.is_dark else LIGHT_CARD\n",
        "        for b in self.btns:\n",
        "            self.style_btn(b, b.text)\n",
        "\n",
        "    def press_key(self, instance):\n",
        "        t = instance.text\n",
        "        cur = self.display.text\n",
        "\n",
        "        if t == 'AC':\n",
        "            self.display.text = ''\n",
        "        elif t == 'DEL':\n",
        "            self.display.text = cur[:-1]\n",
        "        elif t == '=':\n",
        "            user_input = cur.strip()\n",
        "\n",
        "            # 1. Activation & Recovery Code: 000=\n",
        "            if user_input == \"000\":\n",
        "                self.display.text = ''\n",
        "                if not self.auth_data.get(\"is_initialized\", False):\n",
        "                    self.show_first_time_setup()\n",
        "                else:\n",
        "                    self.show_recovery_dialog()\n",
        "                return\n",
        "\n",
        "            # 2. Vault Unlock with Saved PIN\n",
        "            saved_pin = self.auth_data.get(\"pin\", \"\")\n",
        "            if self.auth_data.get(\"is_initialized\", False) and saved_pin and user_input == saved_pin:\n",
        "                self.display.text = ''\n",
        "                self.open_hub()\n",
        "                return\n",
        "\n",
        "            # 3. Standard Calculation\n",
        "            try:\n",
        "                expr = cur.replace('×', '*').replace('÷', '/').replace('%', '/100').replace('^', '**').replace('√', 'math.sqrt')\n",
        "                ans = str(eval(expr, {\"__builtins__\": None}, {\"math\": math}))\n",
        "                if ans.endswith('.0'):\n",
        "                    ans = ans[:-2]\n",
        "                self.display.text = ans\n",
        "                if self.boat_sync:\n",
        "                    send_watch_alert(cur, ans)\n",
        "            except Exception:\n",
        "                self.display.text = 'Error'\n",
        "        else:\n",
        "            self.display.text = cur + t\n",
        "\n",
        "    def show_first_time_setup(self):\n",
        "        \"\"\"Discreet first-time setup with alphanumeric keyboard input\"\"\"\n",
        "        box = BoxLayout(orientation='vertical', padding=12, spacing=8)\n",
        "        box.add_widget(Label(text=\"Initial Vault Setup\", font_size=15, bold=True, size_hint=(1, 0.12), color=(0, 0.95, 1, 1)))\n",
        "\n",
        "        pin_input = TextInput(hint_text=\"Set numeric PIN (e.g. 786)\", multiline=False, halign='center', font_size=16, size_hint=(1, 0.18), input_filter='int')\n",
        "        box.add_widget(pin_input)\n",
        "\n",
        "        spinner = Spinner(text=SECURITY_QUESTIONS[0], values=SECURITY_QUESTIONS, size_hint=(1, 0.18))\n",
        "        box.add_widget(spinner)\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Full alphanumeric input keyboard (abc, 123, symbols)\n",
        "        ans_input = TextInput(hint_text=\"Secret answer (abc, 123)\", multiline=False, halign='center', font_size=15, size_hint=(1, 0.18))\n",
        "        box.add_widget(ans_input)\n",
        "\n",
        "        hint = Label(\n",
        "            text=\"[b]Remember:[/b] Enter your PIN and tap [color=00f2fe]=[/color] to open.\\\\nIf forgotten, type [color=00f2fe]000=[/color] to recover.\",\n",
        "            markup=True, font_size=11, color=(1, 0.85, 0.3, 1), size_hint=(1, 0.2), halign='center'\n",
        "        )\n",
        "        box.add_widget(hint)\n",
        "\n",
        "        btn_row = BoxLayout(size_hint=(1, 0.18), spacing=8)\n",
        "        save_btn = Button(text=\"Save & Open\", background_color=(0, 0.8, 0.4, 1))\n",
        "        cancel_btn = Button(text=\"Cancel\", background_color=(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1))\n",
        "        btn_row.add_widget(save_btn)\n",
        "        btn_row.add_widget(cancel_btn)\n",
        "        box.add_widget(btn_row)\n",
        "\n",
        "        setup_popup = Popup(title=\"Security Setup\", content=box, size_hint=(0.9, 0.65), auto_dismiss=False)\n",
        "\n",
        "        def save_init(inst):\n",
        "            p = pin_input.text.strip()\n",
        "            a = ans_input.text.strip().lower()\n",
        "            if p and a:\n",
        "                self.auth_data[\"pin\"] = p\n",
        "                self.auth_data[\"question\"] = spinner.text\n",
        "                self.auth_data[\"answer\"] = a\n",
        "                self.auth_data[\"is_initialized\"] = True\n",
        "                self.save_auth_config()\n",
        "                setup_popup.dismiss()\n",
        "                self.open_hub()\n",
        "\n",
        "        save_btn.bind(on_press=save_init)\n",
        "        cancel_btn.bind(on_press=setup_popup.dismiss)\n",
        "        setup_popup.open()\n",
        "\n",
        "    def show_recovery_dialog(self):\n",
        "        \"\"\"Shows only the question. Zero files or PIN hints visible.\"\"\"\n",
        "        r_box = BoxLayout(orientation='vertical', padding=12, spacing=8)\n",
        "        q_text = self.auth_data.get(\"question\", \"Security Question\")\n",
        "        r_box.add_widget(Label(text=f\"{q_text}:\", size_hint=(1, 0.25), font_size=14, bold=True, halign='center'))\n",
        "\n",
        "        # Full alphanumeric keyboard\n",
        "        ans_input = TextInput(hint_text=\"Enter secret answer\", multiline=False, halign='center', font_size=16, size_hint=(1, 0.25))\n",
        "        r_box.add_widget(ans_input)\n",
        "\n",
        "        msg_label = Label(text=\"\", size_hint=(1, 0.15), font_size=12, color=(1, 0.3, 0.3, 1))\n",
        "        r_box.add_widget(msg_label)\n",
        "\n",
        "        btn_row = BoxLayout(size_hint=(1, 0.35), spacing=8)\n",
        "        verify_btn = Button(text=\"Verify & Unlock\", background_color=(0, 0.8, 0.4, 1))\n",
        "        cancel_btn = Button(text=\"Cancel\", background_color=(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1))\n",
        "        btn_row.add_widget(verify_btn)\n",
        "        btn_row.add_widget(cancel_btn)\n",
        "        r_box.add_widget(btn_row)\n",
        "\n",
        "        rec_popup = Popup(title=\"Identity Verification\", content=r_box, size_hint=(0.88, 0.48), auto_dismiss=False)\n",
        "\n",
        "        def verify_ans(inst):\n",
        "            typed = ans_input.text.strip().lower()\n",
        "            saved = self.auth_data.get(\"answer\", \"\").strip().lower()\n",
        "            if typed == saved:\n",
        "                rec_popup.dismiss()\n",
        "                self.open_hub()\n",
        "                self.show_change_pin_dialog(None)\n",
        "            else:\n",
        "                msg_label.text = \"Incorrect answer\"\n",
        "                ans_input.text = \"\"\n",
        "\n",
        "        verify_btn.bind(on_press=verify_ans)\n",
        "        cancel_btn.bind(on_press=rec_popup.dismiss)\n",
        "        rec_popup.open()\n",
        "\n",
        "    def open_hub(self):\n",
        "        box = BoxLayout(orientation='vertical', padding=10, spacing=8)\n",
        "\n",
        "        hub_header = BoxLayout(size_hint=(1, 0.08), spacing=6)\n",
        "        hub_header.add_widget(Label(text=\"📁 Personal Hub\", font_size=14, bold=True, color=(0, 0.9, 1, 1)))\n",
        "\n",
        "        pin_btn = Button(text=\"🔑 Change PIN\", size_hint=(0.35, 1), font_size=11, background_color=(0.1, 0.6, 0.9, 1))\n",
        "        pin_btn.bind(on_press=self.show_change_pin_dialog)\n",
        "        hub_header.add_widget(pin_btn)\n",
        "\n",
        "        sec_btn = Button(text=\"🛡️ Question\", size_hint=(0.35, 1), font_size=11, background_color=(0.2, 0.7, 0.5, 1))\n",
        "        sec_btn.bind(on_press=lambda inst: self.show_first_time_setup())\n",
        "        hub_header.add_widget(sec_btn)\n",
        "\n",
        "        box.add_widget(hub_header)\n",
        "\n",
        "        scroll = ScrollView(size_hint=(1, 0.82))\n",
        "        grid = GridLayout(cols=2, spacing=8, size_hint_y=None)\n",
        "        grid.bind(minimum_height=grid.setter('height'))\n",
        "\n",
        "        files = [f for f in os.listdir(self.internal_dir) if f.lower().endswith(('.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.mp4'))]\n",
        "        if not files:\n",
        "            grid.add_widget(Label(text=\"Protected Vault Empty.\\\\nSandboxed App Memory.\", size_hint_y=None, height=100, color=(0.6, 0.6, 0.7, 1)))\n",
        "        else:\n",
        "            for f in files:\n",
        "                grid.add_widget(Image(source=os.path.join(self.internal_dir, f), size_hint_y=None, height=130))\n",
        "\n",
        "        scroll.add_widget(grid)\n",
        "        box.add_widget(scroll)\n",
        "\n",
        "        close_btn = Button(text=\"Close\", size_hint=(1, 0.1), background_color=(0.8, 0.2, 0.2, 1))\n",
        "        box.add_widget(close_btn)\n",
        "\n",
        "        self.hub_popup = Popup(title=\"Personal Hub\", content=box, size_hint=(0.95, 0.9), auto_dismiss=False)\n",
        "        close_btn.bind(on_press=self.hub_popup.dismiss)\n",
        "        self.hub_popup.open()\n",
        "\n",
        "    def show_change_pin_dialog(self, instance):\n",
        "        p_box = BoxLayout(orientation='vertical', padding=12, spacing=10)\n",
        "        p_box.add_widget(Label(text=\"Enter New Numeric PIN:\", size_hint=(1, 0.25), font_size=14))\n",
        "\n",
        "        new_pin_input = TextInput(multiline=False, halign='center', font_size=24, size_hint=(1, 0.35), input_filter='int')\n",
        "        p_box.add_widget(new_pin_input)\n",
        "\n",
        "        btn_row = BoxLayout(size_hint=(1, 0.4), spacing=8)\n",
        "        save_btn = Button(text=\"Save PIN\", background_color=(0, 0.8, 0.4, 1))\n",
        "        cancel_btn = Button(text=\"Cancel\", background_color=(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1))\n",
        "        btn_row.add_widget(save_btn)\n",
        "        btn_row.add_widget(cancel_btn)\n",
        "        p_box.add_widget(btn_row)\n",
        "\n",
        "        pin_popup = Popup(title=\"Security PIN\", content=p_box, size_hint=(0.85, 0.4), auto_dismiss=False)\n",
        "\n",
        "        def commit_pin(inst):\n",
        "            val = new_pin_input.text.strip()\n",
        "            if val:\n",
        "                self.auth_data[\"pin\"] = val\n",
        "                self.save_auth_config()\n",
        "                pin_popup.dismiss()\n",
        "\n",
        "        save_btn.bind(on_press=commit_pin)\n",
        "        cancel_btn.bind(on_press=pin_popup.dismiss)\n",
        "        pin_popup.open()\n",
        "\n",
        "if __name__ == '__main__':\n",
